title: Study of Value of Cardiac PET Scans With or Without CT Angiography and/or Measurement of Coronary Flow Reserve
brief_summary: How does PET myocardial perfusion imaging involving CT angiography and measurement of coronary flow reserve affect patient care.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients referred to Kettering Medical Center for PET myocardial perfusion imaging with or without CTA and/or coronary flow reserve measurement.
* Patients over 18 years of age.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who do not consent to participate.
study_population: Patients who undergo Rubidium PET adenosine stress test with or without CT angiography of coronary arteries and/or coronary flow reserve measurment at Kettering Medical Medical Center.
